scope: Fresh article families disjoint from the first evaluated set. Controlled passage copies with article titles, actual sources and eight original fi/sv counterparts; 12 intact controls and 28 exact supported excerpts. This is not full-article population accuracy.
classification_note: Planted categories determine the row; the source check may catch a wrong fact. Controls are source-supported passages, mostly single-language; this does not measure clean multilingual article-pair false-positive rates.
